title: Pava Horiz Ultra Pod Vape Kit
description: Experience a groundbreaking fusion of AI smart technology and premium vaping design with the PAVA Horiz Ultra Pod Kit. This compact, versatile pod vape system sports a highly-portable ‘matchbox’ form factor clad in durable zinc alloy, with four luxurious finishes to choose from. The Horiz Ultra is designed to cater to both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vapers, combining advanced AI and Bluetooth features, vibrant customisation options, and intuitive controls in a truly first-of-its-kind vape device. Powered by a built-in 1300mAh battery, the PAVA Horiz Ultra delivers dependable all-day performance with adjustable output up to 30W. The device features USB-C 5V/2A fast charging, ensuring minimal downtime between sessions. The Horiz Ultra boasts a stunning 2.01-inch TFT colour touchscreen, offering a super-responsive and interactive experience enhanced by a 240x296 resolution TFT display with 200 PPI for clear, responsive control and customisation. Beneath that glossy surface, the PAVA Horiz Ultra introduces revolutionary capabilities, including smart music control and call reminders via Bluetooth connectivity that syncs with your smartphone's apps for notifications, making it the perfect device for multitaskers or smart tech enthusiasts. Effortlessly personalise your vaping sessions with adjustable airflow control for seamless transitions between MTL and RDL styles. The device also features gradient breathing LED lighting, unique inhalation animations, and even standalone games for moments of relaxation. Compatible with the 2ml refillable PAVA Pods, the Horiz Ultra supports multiple coil resistances (0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.2ohm), making it ideal for Nicotine Salts and 50/50 e-liquids. The pod’s leak-resistant side-fill design ensures effortless refills that help keep this eye-catching device clean and ready to use at all times. The PAVA Horiz Ultra Pod Kit redefines pod kit vapes, combining innovative wireless smart technology and AI capabilities; compact, elegant design; with customisation options. We Recommend using 50/50 ( Freebase) or Nic Salts E-LIquid with this kit. Discover our vape liquid and find a flavour that complements this kit. Please Note: This device does not support gamification. When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
